{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|yield=30 cookies|time=1 hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (1½ sticks) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 3 cups [[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham cracker]] crumbs
* 2 cans (14 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
* 3 cups (12 ounces) [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecan]] pieces or [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]]
* ⅓ cup sliced (not slivered) [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat the oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# Place butter in [[Cookbook:Microwave|microwave]]-safe dish, cover with a [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towel]] and microwave on high, for about 45 seconds, or until melted. Remove carefully and stir to melt completely.
# Place the graham-cracker crumbs in a metal 13-by-9-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]].
# Pour melted butter over crumbs, and stir and [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] until all the crumbs are moistened with the butter. Press crumbs firmly and evenly into the bottom of the pan.
# Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the crumb crust. Spread to the edges with the back of a spoon.
# Top evenly with chocolate chips, pecans, and almonds. Press down with a fork.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]], uncovered, for 25–35 minutes or until bubbling slightly along the edges.
# Remove from oven and cool to room temperature.
# Refrigerate until firm for 1–2 hours before slicing.
# Store at room temperature, covered with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]].
